interpretations: For each `rental.staff_id`, sum the amounts of all payments with a matching rental record, and divide that sum by the sum of those payments across all rental-handling staff members; return the staff ID, sum, and unrounded fraction.
queries:
SELECT
  r.staff_id,
  SUM(p.amount) AS payment_sum,
  SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS fraction
FROM rental AS r
JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
GROUP BY r.staff_id
raw: For each `rental.staff_id`, sum the amounts of all payments with a matching rental record, and divide that sum by the sum of those payments across all rental-handling staff members; return the staff ID, sum, and unrounded fraction.
